Supplies matching generalized 1:20,000,0: Supplies matching generalised 1:20,000,000 state, county and county-equivalent boundaries for the United States at zoom 7 through TIGERweb. It also supplies generalised primary roads at zooms 6 through 8. These boundaries and roads are simplified for geographic awareness rather than navigation, legal or high-precision use. The generated tile manifest records the source, vintage and attribution.
Supplies the simplified world overview a: Supplies the simplified world overview and the global country, first-level administrative boundary, and populated-place data used to generate local SVG tiles. Coastlines and borders are deliberately generalised: these maps provide enough context to recognise an area while keeping downloads small. They must not be used for surveying, navigation, or authoritative boundary decisions.
